title: The Mirror Image
positive_prompt: A high-end Pixar-style 3D animated cinematic shot. Over-the-shoulder perspective from behind Leo, a plump stylized lion with golden-yellow fur, a large fluffy orange mane, and a royal red velvet cape with a gold embroidered border. Leo is leaning over the edge of an old, weathered stone well. The focal point is the clear, still blue water inside the well, which shows a perfect mirror reflection of Leo's face. The reflection depicts Leo's aggressive expression: a grumpy pout, narrowed amber eyes, and his tiny polished gold crown tilted precariously to the left. Standing beside the well is Robby, a small cream-colored 3D rabbit wearing a vibrant lime green button-up vest and a bright red silk bowtie, wearing a confident, mischievous smirk. Bright morning sunlight, soft global illumination, lush greenery in the background, shallow depth of field focusing on the reflection in the water. Vibrant colors, hyper-detailed fur textures, 8k resolution, cinematic lighting.
negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, watermark, logo, text, cropped, deformed, duplicate, bad anatomy, extra limbs
